body_markdown:
Designed to expand the capabilities of our IEC modular enclosure portfolio, CIB-HD provides increased load capacity for more demanding applications, supporting up to 550 lbs per pair. This additional strength gives greater flexibility when mounting heavier components and equipment inside enclosures.


Available in 600 mm and 800 mm configurations, the profiles are designed for use with IEC Modular Floor Standing Enclosures, helping customers expand the possibilities of their enclosure configurations.


CIB-HD brackets are suited for enclosures in industrial automation, battery energy storage systems, data networking applications, and more.


Main benefits:


- Heavy-duty load capacity
- Robust construction
- Flexible installation


[Check out the product page](https://www.nvent.com/en-us/hoffman/products/profiles-19-inch-profiles-fixing-cib-0)
